map_aerial_night.prompt: A photorealistic aerial drone photograph looking steeply down at the valley of Wickermoor Hollow deep at night, lit only by a full moon, the sky and fields dark blue-black with silver moonlight, mist in the hollows and warm lit windows, one continuous real landscape filling the whole picture edge to edge, no border, no labels, no text: real terrain, real trees and fields, moonlit mist, lit windows: a dark moonlit moor in the middle with a ring of crooked cottages round one huge pale oak, a crooked manor on a hill just north-east of it, a wrecked red train with smoke on the moor to the north-west, a glowing fungal forest in the far north-west corner, snowy mountain peaks and a mine headframe in the hills to the north-west, a dark still lake with a pale sanatorium on a small island and a stone monastery on its shore to the west, golden cornfields with a windmill to the east, a walled cemetery with leaning tombstones in mist to the south-east, a black bayou swamp with a riverboat in the far south, a winding river and dirt roads joining the places.
